# E0333: parameter type that can't be generated

`stilt test` can't generate functions, values of a type that has none, or maps whose keys aren't `Eq` and `Hash`. Take values that it can generate, and build the rest inside the property.

- Rule: [`tests.generable-types`](../../reference/19-tools.md#tests.generable-types)
- Reported at: the parameter's type.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0333:2
/// Applies `f` twice.
/// prop: |f: fn(i64) -> i64, x: i64| twice(f, x) == f(f(x))
fn twice(f: fn(i64) -> i64, x: i64) -> i64 { f(f(x)) }
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
/// Applies `f` twice.
/// prop: |x: i64| twice(|n| n +% 1, x) == x +% 2
fn twice(f: fn(i64) -> i64, x: i64) -> i64 { f(f(x)) }
```
